sections.title: Level 2 Strategy
sections.content: At Level 2, Radar/Web charts include 3 variables, percentage distribution, and missing data. Step 1: Identify all axes and variables. Step 2: Understand the scale and units. Step 3: Recognize patterns from the given data. Step 4: Use logic to find missing values.

sections.title: Understanding 3-Variable Web Chart
sections.content: Step 1: Each axis represents a category and each layer represents a variable (such as Year or Person). Step 2: Compare values of different variables. Step 3: Identify overlap or differences. Step 4: Find the required value.

sections.title: Percentage Distribution
sections.content: Step 1: Identify the total value. Step 2: Divide individual values by the total. Step 3: Multiply by 100 to get percentage. Step 4: Verify that the sum of all percentages is 100%.

sections.title: Missing Data Logic
sections.content: Step 1: Observe given values and total. Step 2: Form an equation (Total = sum of all parts). Step 3: Isolate the missing value. Step 4: Check logical consistency.

sections.title: Multiple Comparison Questions
sections.content: Step 1: Compare values of 2 or 3 variables. Step 2: Find ratio or difference. Step 3: Identify highest/lowest. Step 4: Determine the final answer.

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content: 1. Mixing variables. 2. Not verifying that total percentage equals 100%. 3. Using incorrect equations for missing values. 4. Reading the scale incorrectly.

sections.title: Quick Summary
sections.content: At Level 2, 3-variable comparison, percentage distribution, and missing data logic are important. With correct interpretation and step-wise calculation, questions can be solved easily.

tricks.title: 3-Variable Compare Shortcut
tricks.explanation: Compare all three variables within the same category.

tricks.title: 100% Check Rule
tricks.explanation: In percentage distribution, the total must always be 100%.

tricks.title: Missing Value Trick
tricks.explanation: Subtract known values from the total to find the missing value.

tricks.title: Quick Difference Method
tricks.explanation: Quickly calculate the difference between two values.

tricks.title: Layer Reading Trick
tricks.explanation: Read each layer separately, do not mix them.

tricks.title: Approximation Trick
tricks.explanation: Convert complex values into nearby simple numbers for faster calculation.

tricks.title: Cross Verification
tricks.explanation: Verify the final answer using total or percentage.
tricks.example: The calculated value should match the total.
